standard_prerequisites.name: The axioms of a site
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the transitivity and stability axioms used to combine coverings.

core_obligations: Injections (proof lines 10058-10064): for a map of sheaves the assumption gives, for every object, an embedding of the values into a product of values at objects of the source site, so injectivity after applying the pushforward implies injectivity of the map itself.

Surjections (proof lines 10067-10073): given a surjective pushforward, a section of the target is locally in the image over a covering obtained by refining the given covering, and the axioms of a site show that these local lifts assemble into the statement that the section is locally in the image, whence surjectivity.
proof_roadmap: Use the covering assumption to embed values of sheaves into products of values on the source site.
Refine coverings to lift sections locally and deduce reflection of surjections.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if every object of the target site is covered by images of objects of the source site, then the pushforward reflects injections and surjections (statement lines 10046-10055). The proof is a complete argument in two parts: for injections the covering assumption embeds the values of a sheaf into a product of values on the source site, so injectivity of the pushforward gives injectivity of the map (proof lines 10058-10064); for surjections a section is locally lifted after refining the covering, and the axioms of a site assemble the local lifts (proof lines 10067-10073). The non-formal content is the two verifications. The claim is H2: two written-out arguments with each input named.
